title: [4K] RetroLake V.13.6
description:
Original wallpaper:
https://axiomdesign.deviantart.com/art/Highway-4k-696620104
Used with permission of the artist:
https://www.instagram.com/axiom_design_/

[1440P] RetroLake - Mirrored - V.13 (audio responsive, mirrored and configurable):
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1692834824

[FullHD] RetroLake V.10 (audio responsive):
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1535509973

Performance Version (FullHD, video; legacy):
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1428912236 

Used effects:
- reflection (multiple layers)
- pulse (multiple layers for the stars/water; audio responsive parts)
- water ripple (multiple value steps)
- god rays (multiple layers)
- clouds (multiple value steps)
- and many more

My personal first attempt with Wallpaper Engine. I'm open for suggestions, effects to add, etc.

[b]The time has come! The next (and probably biggest by now) update is here: Version 13 adds further plenty of configurable variables, togglable layers, a possible divide between the two sides and most importantly a cleaner,  complete rework of the water animation, reflection areas and the highway.[/b] 

Changelog V.13:
⦁	added tons of options to configure yourself
⦁	complete rework of the water animation, reflection areas, lines and the highway
⦁	reworked presets (check the Google Doc link in the description/screenshots)
⦁	added simple clock (deactivated by default)
⦁	[b]To check if you have an old version or V.13 look in the config settings: if there are "Stars 
Layer 1" to "Stars Layer 4" you have made the update[/b]. Otherwise you're still on an old version
⦁	[1440P] RetroLake is also on update 13. As many of you use FullHD monitors, you could, if you had two of them, put the [4K] and the [1440P] versions side by side 

__________________________________________________________
[b]The preset list is here! You can choose between 4 presets: [/b]

"Stormy Water, Calm Clouds",
"Clean Green",
"Red Glow, Blue Force" and
"Dark Blue".

Make sure you read the short text before you start. There is a preset list for the [4K] V.13 RetroLake and the mirrored [1440P] V.13 one, though not for [FullHD] X!

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HNosGSNRHjY6aHdzGRuRhUfDAv_s0X0Fis-5yPud2Hk/edit?usp=sharing
__________________________________________________________

My other wallpaper scenes:
[4K] NeonSunset V.3.5:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1398400043

[4K] NightSky V.1:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1422888532

Your support is highly appreciated! Thank you!
